title: Bangsamoro human rights body investigates 2 Basilan ambushes

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur—The Bangsamoro Human Rights Commission (BHRC) Basilan Provincial Office on Friday (Oct. 9) strongly condemned two separate ambushes within a four-day span in Basilan. These incidents left 1 soldier dead and 24 others wounded—including a 10-year-old child and his father. In a statement, the human rights body announced it has launched an investigation into the Oct. 5 attack in Tipo-Tipo and the Oct. 8 ambush in Lamitan City. The commision stated that it will use international humanitarian law (IHL) standards. The Oct. 5 incident occurred in Sitio Bauno Dagao, Barangay Badja, Tipo-Tipo. It wounded 13 government personnel.
